home.subtitle: Real-time speaking time system, party quotas, and broadcast graphics (OBS / vMix)
home.dashboardDesc: Touch-friendly control panel to grant the floor, start/pause the timer, add main speeches and replies, and monitor party time quotas.
home.adminDesc: Customize organization name and logo, import representatives and parties from CSV, and configure agenda items with individual or party quotas.
home.screensHeader: Display Views for Hall and Video Streaming (OBS / vMix Browser Sources)
home.podiumDesc: Full-screen high-contrast display for the podium or hall. Shows large countdown, active speaker, next speakers, and party quotas.
home.lowerThirdDesc: Transparent 1920x1080 overlay with organization logo, speaker name, party color, and optional countdown.
home.agendaBugDesc: Transparent overlay placed in the top-right corner displaying the active agenda item number and title during streaming.
